Mixed filename + URL: only the URL becomes an autolink (#397)

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<a href=\"foobar.png\">foobar.png</a> <a href=\"https://www.heise.de\">https://www.heise.de</a>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
